description: Tracks active open-source AI agent repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: The agent that grows with you
Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS sandboxes, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.

NocoBase is the open-source platform for building, running, and evolving business systems with AI. Agents write the code and do the work, NocoBase provides the foundation and governance, and people make the decisions.
Secure, Fast, and Extensible Sandbox runtime for AI agents.
Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available on desktop and the web.

Omnigent is an open-source AI agent framework and meta-harness: orchestrate Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and custom agents — swap harnesses without rewriting, enforce policies and sandboxing, and collaborate in real time from any device.
Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you.

The open-source AI research workbench for scientific research and agent workflows. Local-first, model-agnostic desktop app with extensible skills, MCP tools and connectors, Python/R execution and traceable artifacts for reproducible research on macOS, Windows and Linux.
The micro-VM for AI agents — light enough to embed on your laptop, elastic enough to power an agentic cloud.

Open source personal agent with its own computer. It chases invoices, preps your calls and cancels trials on real websites, and asks before it acts. Runs on your machine with the model you choose. By n8n.

Open-source GrokBot alternative built on DeepSeek Harness. Build your personal bot team: multiple personal agents with persistent memory, identities and permissions, extensible through DSH plugins.｜基于 DeepSeek Harness 的开源 GrokBot 平替：有长期记忆的个人 AI Bot 团队，支持多 Bot 协作、身份权限与插件生态扩展。MIT.

PiG (Pi in Go) is a faithful Go port of upstream Pi, the TypeScript codebase behind the Pi coding agent. It is a parity-bound translation, not a rewrite: upstream behavior is the contract, and Go is the implementation language.
One person, a team of agents: CLI, Web, Desktop & Python SDK with multi-session collaboration, persistent memory, and self-evolving skills. 一个人，一支 Agent 团队：支持多终端协作、持久记忆与技能自进化的 AI Agent 框架。
